provenance.tool: axe-core 4.14.1 (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA rules: wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa)
provenance.method: `npm run preview` renders the real webview panels (src/webview/*) with data from the seeded backend into static HTML using VS Code's default light theme colours; test/preview/a11y.js runs axe on <main> of each page in a browser. Values below were read from the page output.
provenance.scope_note: Automated rules cover part of WCAG only; keyboard use and screen-reader wording still need a manual check. 'incomplete' = axe could not decide automatically (manual review).
